summary: Completed backend+frontend integration validation for UAO Conecta academic expansion using QA seeded identities and public preview URL. Backend regression suite passed (14/14). Frontend critical flows passed for onboarding role visibility, course create/edit/invite-rotate/join-by-URL, shared tasks/schedules, local dudas, resources, notifications persistence, responsive menu, and real assistant SSE multi-turn persistence.

minor.issue: API accepts invite code only; passing full invite URL directly to backend returns 404. Frontend works because it pre-parses URL and sends only code.

integration_issues.flow: Chats room selection without explicit room query
integration_issues.issue: Automation had intermittent selection timeouts when opening room from list; direct URL /chats?room=<id> worked and real-time messaging succeeded both ways.

action_items: Optionally support full invite URL parsing server-side in /api/courses/join for API-client parity with frontend behavior.
Quick manual sanity check on chat room click-selection (list click path) to confirm no real user-impact flakiness.
critical_code_review_comments: Legacy test file /app/backend/tests/test_auth_api.py still contains URL fallback hardcode; this conflicts with env-only URL rule and should be cleaned in future test maintenance.
Join-by-link behavior currently relies on frontend normalization (CoursesPage); backend contract itself remains code-only.
seed_data_creation: Used existing QA seeded identities via /app/backend/seed_academic_qa.py. Created QA courses/tasks/schedule slots/messages/assistant sessions and local demo entries during UI runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified public app URL only. Chat end-to-end confirmed with two browser contexts using direct room query parameter and polling (3s) with no duplicate message observed. Assistant SSE worked for 2 turns and persisted across reload/new session. Notifications mark-as-read persisted across reload. Resource unsafe protocol rejected. Mobile menu contains required entries and closes on route change.
rca of the issue: The only backend behavior gap found is join-by-full-URL at API level: /api/courses/join expects a code and performs upper/trim only. Frontend already mitigates this by extracting ?join= before request, so user-facing flow works.
